## Wide sweep — Simplify GitHub listings
Fetch the SimplifyJobs Summer 2027 listings.json (~16k roles) then coarse-filter (active, software/AI, Summer 2027, US/remote) then drop IDs already in the DB then cap 40 newest then score with Groq (throttled) then insert.

Run a few times to backfill; after that each run only scores new postings.
